jpg-to-pdf.formula:
scale = min((page width − 2 × margin) ÷ image width,

drawn width = image width × scale    drawn height = image height × scale
howTo: Click “Choose images” and select your photos (JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF).
Reorder them with the arrow buttons — each image becomes one page in this order.
Pick a page size: A4, US Letter, or “Match image” for borderless pages.
Set the margin around each photo.
Click “Create PDF” and download the finished document.

jpg-to-pdf.workedExample:
A 4000×3000 photo on A4 (595.28 × 841.89 pt) with a 36 pt margin:
usable = 523.28 × 769.89 pt
scale = min(523.28 ÷ 4000, 769.89 ÷ 3000) = min(0.1308, 0.2566) = 0.1308
drawn = 4000 × 0.1308 × 3000 × 0.1308 = 523 × 392 pt
The photo fills the page width, centered vertically.
